extension.summary: Functional: a clean, opinionated Kodi skin
extension.description: Functional. Built for clarity: gallery library views, configurable accent colour, slide-out filters, side-by-side library stats on home, and a tight video OSD.
extension.news: New Next Episode Card row under Skin Settings, Playback, off by default. Set to Unwatched or In Order, a card shows the next episode bottom right near the end of a library episode, as the credits start or at the time set on At the Latest. OK plays it at once and Back hides the card. Live TV, specials and a queue that already has a next item get no card. Left off, playback looks as before.
